title: ChangeSet
description: Edits made on a device while offline, sent to the sync engine when the device reconnects.

baseCursor.description: Last server state the device had seen before going offline.

changeId.description: Unique per change; makes re-sending safe.

baseVersion.description: Task version the edit was made against; a mismatch is a conflict.

fields.description: New values for the changed fields.
